# Julián J. Crider · Las Vegas & Henderson Real Estate

> Julián J. Crider is a Las Vegas and Henderson, Nevada Realtor® and luxury real estate agent (Nevada license S.0177760), brokered by Boeckle & Co. and a member of The DeBenedetto Team. He helps people buy, sell, build and relocate across the Las Vegas valley, with a focus on luxury homes, new construction and relocation.

## Contact
- Phone / text: 702-498-2571
- Website: https://juliancrider.com
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/juliancriderestates/
- Office: Boeckle & Co., 4775 W Teco Ave, Suite 220, Las Vegas, NV 89118

## Services
- Luxury home sales and purchases
- New construction: representing buyers at builder communities (Summerlin, Skye Canyon, Cadence, Inspirada and more), usually at no extra cost to the buyer
- Relocating to Las Vegas: a free 33-page relocation guide (https://juliancrider.com/Relocation-Guide.pdf) covering neighborhoods, schools, hospitals, the DMV, dining and things to do
- Home valuations for sellers, with a written opinion of value based on recent nearby sales
- Live MLS home search and showing requests on juliancrider.com
- Investment and commercial property

## Areas served
Las Vegas, Henderson, Summerlin, The Ridges, Red Rock Country Club, The Summit, Queensridge, MacDonald Highlands, Anthem, Green Valley Ranch, Seven Hills, Lake Las Vegas, Southern Highlands, Skye Canyon, Providence, Iron Mountain Ranch, Mountain's Edge, Rhodes Ranch, Inspirada, Cadence, Aliante, Spring Valley and Enterprise.

## Good to know
- Julián's business is built mostly on referrals and repeat clients.
- Buyers sign a short written agreement before touring homes, as required since 2024. For a single showing, Julián uses a non-exclusive agreement that covers only that one home.
- Nevada has no state income tax, a common reason people relocate to Las Vegas and Henderson.
